objective: Continue optimizing the dependency-free PNG decoder until faster/more optimized than Rust image/png in CPU cycles and allocations.
scope: Buffered static PNG decoding on the recorded Windows x86-64 host, using the unchanged 89-image corpus and pinned reference versions. CPU comparisons describe corpus averages, not universal per-file or hardware guarantees.
required_cpu_evidence: Both independent processes use fewer geometric-mean cycles and fewer total measured cycles than normalized png and image in every corpus group; overall packed-API cycles also lower in both processes.
limits: Some individual images still use more CPU cycles.
Packed sub-byte output performs different expansion work.
Streaming/APNG throughput and other architectures were not timed.
